description: This file contains implementation of core device management commands for a device service, including device listing, detail printing, resource management, device discovery, metadata handling, system property access, and device descriptor control, with command registration in a 'Core' category.

methods.name: listDeviceEntry
methods.description: Prints details of a device, including its endpoints and resources, with labels.

methods.name: getDeviceLabel
methods.description: Finds the best label resource for a device.

methods.name: printDeviceEntry
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a device, including resources, endpoints, and metadata.

methods.name: printDeviceFunc
methods.description: Retrieves a device by ID and prints its details.

methods.name: printAllDevicesFunc
methods.description: Retrieves and prints details of all devices or devices in a class.

methods.name: listDevicesFunc
methods.description: Lists devices, optionally filtered by device class.

methods.name: getDeviceCountBySubsystemFunc
methods.description: Gets and prints the number of devices in a subsystem.

methods.name: readResourceFunc
methods.description: Reads and prints the value of a resource by URI.

methods.name: writeResourceFunc
methods.description: Writes a value to a resource by URI.

methods.name: execResourceFunc
methods.description: Executes a resource command by URI, optionally with an argument.

methods.name: queryResourcesCompareFunc
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting resources by URI.

methods.name: queryResourcesFunc
methods.description: Queries resources matching a pattern and displays them.

methods.name: changeResourceModeFunc
methods.description: Changes the mode of a resource.

methods.name: readMetadataFunc
methods.description: Reads metadata for a given URI.

methods.name: writeMetadataFunc
methods.description: Writes metadata for a given URI.

methods.name: queryMetadataFunc
methods.description: Queries metadata by URI pattern.

methods.name: discoverRepairStartFunc
methods.description: Starts discovery of orphaned devices for a class.

methods.name: discoverStartFunc
methods.description: Starts discovery of devices for a class.

methods.name: discoverStopFunc
methods.description: Stops device discovery.

methods.name: removeDeviceFunc
methods.description: Removes a device by ID.

methods.name: removeEndpointFunc
methods.description: Removes an endpoint by URI.

methods.name: removeDevicesFunc
methods.description: Removes all devices or devices of a class, with confirmation.

methods.name: dumpResource
methods.description: Prints detailed info about a resource.

methods.name: dumpEndpoint
methods.description: Prints detailed info about an endpoint.

methods.name: dumpDeviceFunc
methods.description: Prints detailed info about a device, including resources, endpoints, and metadata.

methods.name: dumpDevicesFunc
methods.description: Prints details of all devices.

methods.name: readSystemPropertyFunc
methods.description: Reads a system property.

methods.name: writeSystemPropertyFunc
methods.description: Writes a system property.

methods.name: reloadDatabaseFunc
methods.description: Instructs device service to reload its database.

methods.name: setDDlOverride
methods.description: Sets device descriptor override URL.

methods.name: ddlFunc
methods.description: Handles device descriptor control commands: override, clearoverride, process, bypass, clearbypass.

methods.name: printListWithCommas
methods.description: Prints list items separated by commas.

methods.name: getStatusFunc
methods.description: Retrieves and displays device service status.

methods.name: buildCoreCategory
methods.description: Creates and returns the 'Core' command category with all core commands registered.
